categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with electoral processes - the certification and publication of supplementary electoral registers under the Registration of Electors Act. It provides official notice about electoral district registers, inspection locations, and is issued by the Commissioner General of Elections and Election Commission, making it clearly about electoral administration matters.
